messages:
deploy-bot: SAFETY-VALVE triggered for embeddings-service — p95 > 350ms for last 3m. Auto-bailout executed: traffic rerouted to fallback-model v2.1.6. Auto-bailout reason: kvcache-miss storm. Suggested action: ops review and decide manual hold or allow fallback to continue. :warning:
jordan: seeing the same in logs. can we get a quick root cause? how big is the user impact?
sam: kvcache invalidations across host pool after the recent kv-compat patch. lots of cold-starts causing large seq prep time. impact mostly embed endpoints and long-seq chat requests. ~4% of total traffic hit fallback.
lee: recommend pining traffic to v2.1.6 for now and stop the automated cutover until patch verified. we should avoid flip-flopping for customers on dedicated pools. :point_up:
rebecca: agree with pin. i'll draft a short customer note for any affected enterprise tenants and update release notes with the incident note. cc: support for templates.
oncall-ml: if we pin, we should also disable the safety-valve for the next 10m while we validate the hotfix — else the bot will re-trigger. command to disable: `/ops feature-toggle safety_valve embeddings-service off --reason "hotfix-verify"`
jordan: ok. @oncall-ml can you run the disable and then apply the kvcache hotpatch? i'll coordinate traffic pin.
oncall-ml: disabling safety_valve now. running hotpatch rollout to 3 hosts (canary). logs: ```patch: apply kvcache-fix v1.0.1
rolling to host-12, host-23, host-34
monitoring p95 and kvcache hit-rate
```
sam: hotpatch applied to canary hosts. p95 down to 180ms on canary. hit-rate improved. ready to escalate to remaining pool if jordan gives the go.
jordan: escalate to rest of pool. pin traffic to v2.1.6 for 30m while we finish rollout and confirm stability. i will update this thread when pin lifted. :white_check_mark:
rebecca: customer note sent to affected list and release notes updated (draft saved).
lee: once we lift pin, enable safety_valve back to on and let deploy-bot run normal thresholds. also recommend follow-up postmortem and adding a preflight kvwarming step to release docs.
jordan: agreed. postmortem + changelog entry. lifting pin ETA +45m after full rollout.
deploy-bot: NOTE: auto-bailout remains active and will resume once safety_valve is re-enabled. Current traffic pinned to fallback-model v2.1.6 by manual override.
